title: Restore generated-artifact refresh through a read-only V3 request and trusted workflow-run dispatcher

phases.objective: Restore an observable exact-head path to the registered V2 generated-artifact decision workflow through a strictly read-only pull-request request artifact and a separately trusted workflow-run dispatcher.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted default-branch V3 request workflow and trusted workflow-run V3 dispatcher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository pull request targeting main is labeled, synchronized, reopened, or marked ready while carrying generated-artifact-refresh, or an explicit exact-head manual request is submitted.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The pull-request stage emits a read-only exact-head request artifact; the independent workflow-run dispatcher downloads that exact artifact, revalidates the current pull request, dispatches V2 on main, and observes a new V2 run without candidate checkout or repository mutation.
steps: Run the V3 request workflow from protected default-branch workflow code.
Require an open non-draft same-repository PR targeting main, governed branch syntax, exact current head SHA, and generated-artifact-refresh label.
Upload mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh-request.v1 with V3 identity and explicit no-write assertions.
Trigger the V3 dispatcher only from the completed named request workflow or explicit workflow_dispatch.
Download the exact source-run artifact and reject source-run substitution.
Re-read and revalidate PR state, repository identity, base, branch, label, and exact head SHA.
Dispatch governed-generated-artifact-refresh-dispatch-v2.yml on main with target_ref and expected_head_sha.
Observe a concrete new V2 workflow_dispatch run within a bounded window and fail closed otherwise.
assertions: The pull-request request workflow grants contents:read and pull-requests:read only, performs no checkout, workflow dispatch, comment publication, repository mutation, push, or secret access.
The write-capable V3 dispatcher has workflow_run and workflow_dispatch entrypoints but no pull_request, pull_request_target, issue_comment, or push trigger.
The dispatcher has actions:write only for V2 delegation and keeps contents and pull requests read-only without issue-write authority.
The dispatcher validates an exact run-bound V3 request artifact and current PR identity before API mutation.
Forks, drafts, stale heads, substituted artifacts, missing labels, invalid branches, main, and Production fail closed.
The dispatcher never checks out candidate or trusted code, never writes repository contents, and never invokes the generated-artifact writer directly.
V2 remains the canonical decision publisher and the only workflow allowed to delegate to the governed writer.
Passed V3 evidence requires v2_run_observed=true and a numeric v2_run_id.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only and secrets_included=false.

phases.objective: Observe one eligible PR event produce a V3 request artifact, a V3 dispatcher run, a V2 canonical decision, and a bounded generated writer commit.
Exercise fork, draft, stale head, source-run substitution, missing label, invalid branch, inactive V2, rejected dispatch, and unobserved V2 run without candidate checkout or repository mutation.
This repository-control bridge performs no external provider or deployment canary.
The bridge rejects protected branches and grants no migration, deployment, runtime, provider, credential, or Production authority.
